# Model 2 — K-Nearest Neighbors

KNN classifies prospects by the outcomes of similar combine attendees. Its distances require scaled variables. We use the same **5-fold `caret` Kappa tuning** as the class automation example, varying `k` rather than selecting it using the final holdout.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
dir.create("objects", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
train_x_scaled <- readRDS("objects/train_x_scaled.rds")
test_x_scaled <- readRDS("objects/test_x_scaled.rds")
train_y <- readRDS("objects/train_y.rds")
```

```{r analysis}
library(caret)
set.seed(12345)
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, classProbs = TRUE)

# Larger k makes more neighbors vote; Kappa selects k without using test labels.
knn_model <- train(x = train_x_scaled, y = train_y, method = "knn",
                   trControl = ctrl, metric = "Kappa",
                   tuneGrid = expand.grid(k = c(5, 11, 21, 31)))
print(knn_model$results)
cat("Selected k:", knn_model$bestTune$k, "
")

# Save class-1 probabilities; keep 0/1 classes for confusion matrices.
knn_prob <- as.numeric(predict(knn_model, test_x_scaled, type = "prob")[, "Drafted"])
knn_pred <- factor(ifelse(knn_prob >= 0.5, "Drafted", "Undrafted"),
                   levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted"))

```

```{r save-results, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(knn_model, "objects/knn_model.rds")
saveRDS(knn_model$results, "objects/knn_cv.rds")
saveRDS(knn_prob, "objects/knn_prob.rds")
saveRDS(knn_pred, "objects/knn_pred.rds")
```
